request.text: [cheerful] [fast] Salves! Flasks! Wraps for cold mornings! Amber only, Majesty. I'm a simple bug.

text: Salves! Flasks! Wraps for cold mornings! Amber only, Majesty. I'm a simple bug.

voice.description: A cheerful travelling merchant, middle-aged: a round, chirpy, slightly nasal tenor voice, fast-talking and eager to sell, a little cheeky, comic and friendly like a market hawker. He speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
